headline: Colombian Congress Passes President De la Espriella's Submission Law
summary: Colombia's Congress approved the Submission Law, the centerpiece of President Abelardo de la Espriella's security strategy to combat criminal organizations and illegal armed groups following tight votes in the Senate and House.
why: Legislative changes to national security and legal frameworks can alter domestic stability, investor confidence, and country risk premiums.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: New security legislation alters the legal framework for criminal prosecution and armed group submission.
